statement: DATO: Table 1 of PMID 34634460 (Synapsin-Cre neuron-specific deletion, layer II/III pyramidal neurons, P13-P17, acute slices) gives input resistance 102.88 / 143.26 / 143.03 megaohm (WT / HT / KO), about 40 percent higher in both mutants, N cells/animals 13/5, 15/6, 40/15; Table 1 does not say whether the plus-minus is SD or SEM, the Fig 6B legend says SEM, and no analysis unit is declared. INFERENZA: the same step drives higher-Rin cells further (about 20.6 v 28.7 mV), so the table does not compare sag at matched potential; the passive reading explains part of the sag rise, the non-linear remainder is undetermined. INFERENZA (review 37982354): open HCN channels depolarise RMP but also lower Rin, whereas Wwox cells show depolarised RMP with Rin raised, a pattern of fewer open conductances (and a lower implied capacitance), which the report does not address. Printed p values and asterisks for some contrasts (sag in HT, rebound in KO; RMP in HT has only an asterisk, no printed p) are not reproducible under assumed Welch/SEM with cells as units; the two sag p values in the Fig 6B legend are not labelled by comparison; this is not a contradiction of the paper (operator rule: no definitive contradiction using a statistical model the authors did not declare).
